title: docs(pm-dispatch): seat sessions run at effort high, checked at seat-taking
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xEoMvrXkLxpo1LDGr7sbUKZ)_
Fixes #28901

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 席位规则 `seat-lifecycle.md` 的坐席同笔后加一行:分诊席与车道席会话 effort 恒 `high`;坐席时低于即在登记行注明,请账号主人以 `high` 重开。
- **为什么改:** 落实裁决「同意，分诊，车道经理都用 high」与「写进席位规则」;派出的 dev 仍按卡定 effort,`SKILL.md` 与 `execution-duties.md` 未动。
- **风险与回滚:** 纯指令文本,一增一删,文件仍 96 行(上限 96);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` 坐席同笔下的新行,和被删的「范围与常设承诺是岗位说明不是状态」一行。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期 seat-lifecycle.md 96 行、headroom 0、退出码 0。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md`, in the seat-taking stroke (right after the `坐席同笔` line): one new rule line. The triage seat and every lane seat run their session at effort `high`. A seat that takes a seat below `high` says so in its registration line and asks its account owner to restart it at `high`. Not a gate and not a label.
- **Reader:** every seat on every fire. `SKILL.md`'s phase index routes every seat, triage included, to `seat-lifecycle.md` on every fire, so this one line is the shared section the card allows. No lane file needed its own pointer.
- **Paid by deletion, not by raising the ceiling:** the file stood at 96/96. The line removed is `范围与常设承诺是岗位说明不是状态,版本化在 references/lanes/LANE.md`. Every lane charter already says this in its own header (`本文是本车道岗位说明,现值状态恒在座位贴`), and the same seat reads that charter on the same fire. The next line (`贴内只放指向车道文件的指针`) keeps the post-side half. Raising the ceiling would mean editing `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, which is outside the claimed file surface.
- Untouched: `SKILL.md`'s per-card dev effort rule, and the `xhigh` floor in `execution-duties.md`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's suggested route also put one pointer line in `lanes/triage.md` and in each lane file. I didn't take it. Every seat already reaches `seat-lifecycle.md` on every fire through `SKILL.md`'s phase index, and `triage.md`, `server.md`, `ui.md`, `hotcrm.md` and `director.md` are all at headroom 0, so each pointer would cost a deletion and add no reader.

- `grep -c "effort 恒" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` gives 1. `grep -c "版本化在"` on the same file gives 0. `wc -l` gives 96.
